blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: Exploring everything Tanzania has to offer is high on many wish lists. Spot Africa’s Big Five on an epic Tanzania safari adventure, climb Kilimanjaro or relax on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania gives you all of it. Happily, Your Tanzania Trip can draw up a custom made itinerary that meets all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: You can find some inspiration in our most popular itineraries. The majority of our clients like to close their exciting safari with a few days of relaxing on one of Zanzibar’s most beautiful beaches. Would you like to do that as well?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: Choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or let us adapt your journey to your own ideas; we are glad to help you either way. Join us and get ready to see Tanzania at your own pace, in just the way you prefer!

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide meets you when you land at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He drives you to your hotel, where you can relax after your flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Preparing for your climb: You get together with your guide before the climb starts. He briefs you and advises you on what to wear and pack, and shares other important tips so that the climb is as comfortable as possible.

blocks.orig: The first morning, your guide takes you from the hotel to Marangu Gate. The first part leads you through coffee and banana plantations and then you cross some untouched rainforest. After a seven-hour hike, you reach the Mandara huts. In the afternoon you have the option to go to the Maundi crater, a volcanic crater near the Mandara Huts or you can just rest and enjoy the beautiful surroundings. As this is your first day at this altitude, remember to drink plenty of water!
blocks.html: On the first morning your guide drives you from the hotel to Marangu Gate. You first walk through coffee and banana plantations, after which you pass through untouched rainforest. A seven-hour hike brings you to the Mandara huts. In the afternoon you can walk to the Maundi crater, a volcanic crater near the Mandara Huts, or simply rest and enjoy the lovely surroundings. This is your first day at this altitude, so remember to drink lots of water!

blocks.orig: From Mandara Huts, the landscape slowly changes from cloud forests to grass plains with some heather and other vegetation. The higher you go, the less vegetation can be seen and the more it starts to look like a lunar landscape. The air is also becoming thinner now. A few hours after lunch you can make an acclimatization hike with an ascent of 200 meters and then return to Horombo Huts for dinner and overnight.
blocks.html: After Mandara Huts the scenery gradually turns from cloud forest into grass plains with heather and other plants. The higher you climb, the less vegetation you see, and the more it looks like a lunar landscape. By now the air is getting thinner as well. A few hours after lunch you can go on an acclimatisation hike that climbs 200 meters, before returning to Horombo Huts for dinner and the night.

blocks.orig: Today your hike leads through a kind of Alpine desert to a point between the two famous mountain peaks Kibo and Mawenzi. The hike is heavy and takes you through open landscapes with less shelter. You arrive at Kibo camp for lunch, after which you can relax in preparation for the big day ahead!
blocks.html: Today the hike takes you through a sort of Alpine desert to a spot between Kibo and Mawenzi, the two famous mountain peaks. It is a tough walk through open terrain that offers less shelter. You reach Kibo camp for lunch and can then rest to prepare for the big day!

blocks.orig: In the middle of the night, you start your ascent to Uhuru Peak, with your flashlight. The biggest challenge lies in the first part of this climb until you reach Gilman's Point. From here, Uhuru Peak is not far and is relatively easy to reach. Once at the summit, enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! After celebrating this achievement at the top, your descent begins through the Kibo Huts Camp down to the Horombo huts for dinner and overnight. In total, you are on your feet for about twelve hours today, so prepare yourself for a hard but rewarding day!
blocks.html: In the middle of the night you begin the climb to Uhuru Peak, by the light of your flashlight. The first part of the climb, up to Gilman's Point, is the hardest. From there Uhuru Peak is close and fairly easy to reach. At the summit you can enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is very impressive at this altitude! Once you have celebrated your success at the top, you start the descent via the Kibo Huts Camp to the Horombo huts for dinner and the night. Altogether you are on your feet for around twelve hours today, so be prepared for a tough but rewarding day!

blocks.orig: On this final day on the mountain, you descend to Marangu gate, the exit of Kilimanjaro National Park. This is a wonderful five to six-hour walk through the beautiful forests of Kilimanjaro. Your guide then takes you to your hotel, where you get a well-deserved rest.
blocks.html: On your last day on the mountain you walk down to Marangu gate, where you exit Kilimanjaro National Park. It is a lovely walk of five to six hours through Kilimanjaro's beautiful forests. Afterwards your guide drives you to the hotel for a well-earned rest.

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday has reached its end, and it is time to go back home. Enjoy your final hours in Tanzania before our driver collects you and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight. Still want more? It is also possible to extend your Kilimanjaro adventure with a few days of safari or a beach holiday!
